title: Quadratic variation of an Itô row up to a fixed dyadic time
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Quadratic variation of an Itô row up to a fixed dyadic time. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Let X be the sum of a drift with almost surely continuous finite-variation paths on [0,T] and a finite row of completed scalar Itô integrals. The integrals are driven by the coordinates of a standard vector Brownian motion relative to the given filtration and measure. For a fixed coarse dyadic time τ, the prefix sums of squared fine-grid increments of X converge in measure to the integrated squared row norm up to τ.
